title: AssetWarranty - Data API
description: Defines the warranty terms applicable to an asset along with any exclusions and extensions. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

AssetId.description: The ID of the asset this warranty term applies to.

AssetWarrantyNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
AssetWarrantyNumber.description: The identifier of the asset warranty record.

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The date on which this warranty term expires.

ExchangeType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExchangeType.description: The type of exchange offered by this warranty term.

ExpensesCoveredEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpensesCoveredEndDate.description: The date on which cover for expenses ends.

IsTransferable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsTransferable.description: Defines whether the warranty term can be transferred to a new owner.

LaborCoveredEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LaborCoveredEndDate.description: The date on which cover for labor ends.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the asset warranty term was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the asset warranty term was last viewed.

PartsCoveredEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartsCoveredEndDate.description: The date on which cover for parts ends.

Pricebook2Id.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Pricebook2Id.description: The ID of the price book item associated with this asset warranty term.

StartDate.description: The date on which cover under this warranty term starts.

WarrantyTermId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WarrantyTermId.description: The ID of the warranty term this asset warranty term extends.

WarrantyType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **AssetWarrantyChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
